colour_management: AgX (Blender) / AgXToneMapping (three.js); albedo textures sRGB, data linear

kz_core.uv_convention: UV0 in metres (1 UV unit = 1 m). Texture coordinate = uv / scale. Textures are authored with v = 1 on the first image row (glTF/Blender convention).
kz_core.normal_convention: Tangent space, OpenGL / glTF (+Y = +v). normal_height.rg = XY*0.5+0.5, z = sqrt(1 - x^2 - y^2); normalScale = normal_strength.
formulas: h = height (orm.a or normal_height.b), ao = orm.r
albedo = mix(albedo, foam_color, foam)            // foam = base.a for transparent materials
rough  = mix(rough, 0.04, wet_m); rough = clamp(mix(rough, 0.45, foam), 0, 1)
emissive = emissive_map_or_white * emissive_color * tint, intensity = emit_strength * emissive_level
attenuationColor = absorb_color * tint (three.js: attenuationColor/attenuationDistance given per material)
In three.js the AO term is applied as aoMap (orm.r) on the baked lightMap, not multiplied into albedo.
kz_core.note: All lighting is baked irradiance (AGENT_PROMPT_3D 7.1); these textures carry albedo/ORM/detail only. View transform AgX in Blender and AgXToneMapping in three.js (7.5).
